items.title: Pentagon breach hit 2.76 million living personnel after 9-month undetected access
items.summary: Unauthorized users exploited a flaw in a Defense Manpower Data Center file-sharing system from October 2025 to July 2026, accessing unencrypted records with Social Security numbers, dates of birth, and military occupational specialties.

items.title: Apple patches CoreGraphics zero-day used in 'extremely sophisticated' targeted attacks
items.summary: CVE-2026-86950 is an out-of-bounds write allowing arbitrary code execution when a device processes a crafted file; reported by Meta's product security team. Fixed in iOS 26.7.1, iPadOS 26.7.1, macOS Tahoe 26.7.1, and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1.

items.title: Citrix patches actively exploited NetScaler zero-days after a weekend of unofficial warnings
items.summary: CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 (both CVSS 9.5) allow remote code execution and were observed under attack before Citrix published its Sunday advisory; a CISA alert followed.

items.title: Japan's Keio Corp confirms ransomware attack disrupted business systems
items.summary: The railway and hotel operator isolated its network after discovering hacked servers on September 26; police have been notified and external experts are investigating the breach route and data impact.

items.title: 6 million Mi Argentina citizen records allegedly offered for sale on dark web
items.summary: An unverified forum listing claims a database with DNI numbers, passwords, fingerprint data, and addresses tied to Argentina's government digital identity platform; no independent confirmation of a breach exists.
